meta.description: A fixed ten-question English and Korean general-knowledge practice round with answers and explanations. No timer or ranking.

app.title: World Knowledge Sprint
app.subtitle: Take one calm lap through ten stable general-knowledge questions.
app.method: Method: ten fixed questions, one point for each correct answer, and a score out of ten. Every answer includes a short explanation.
app.boundary: This practice round has no timer and does not estimate intelligence, education level, rank, or percentile. Facts were reviewed on September 5, 2026.

result.summary: You answered {score} of 10 questions correctly in this fixed set.
result.method: The score is simply the number of correct answers in this fixed set.
result.boundary: It is not a comparison with other people and does not measure intelligence.

share.text: Try this calm ten-question knowledge sprint.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the solar system's largest planet by both diameter and mass.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom: H₂O.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is Japan's capital and the seat of its national government.

questions.prompt: How many months are in one calendar year?
questions.explanation: The Gregorian calendar divides a year into 12 months.

questions.prompt: Which mountain has the highest summit above sea level?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest has the world's highest summit above mean sea level.

questions.prompt: Which gas makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Dry air near sea level is about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen by volume.
WWW is the abbreviation for World Wide Web.

questions.prompt: How many bits are in one byte?
questions.explanation: In modern computing, one byte conventionally contains eight bits.
Vincent van Gogh painted The Starry Night in 1889.

questions.prompt: Which color is not one of the five Olympic rings?
questions.explanation: The ring colors are blue, yellow, black, green, and red on a white background.
